title.en: An Act Declaring the 2nd of August of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Butuan
title.orig: An Act Declaring the 2nd of August of Every Year as a Special Working Public Holiday in the City of Butuan

completenessNote: 全文，共 2 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2000/ra_8802_2000.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: August 2 of every year is hereby declared as a special working public holiday in the City of Butuan, in recognition and in commemoration of the city's charter foundation day.
This Act shall take effect immediately upon its approval.
